content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a good day. I am writing to suggest a quick update to the agreement before we proceed. - In the relevant clause regarding liability, claims under Section 9 are excluded from the overall cap, which leaves potential exposure completely uncapped; I propose we change this so that the liability of a party to the other for direct damages shall not exceed Fifteen Million Dollars in the aggregate, including any claims under Section 9 hereof. Thank you for considering this adjustment.
